def get_remote_odb(
        self,
        name: Optional[str] = None,
        command: str = "<command>",
        hash_name: str = "md5",
    ) -> "HashFileDB":
        from dvc.cachemgr import LEGACY_HASH_NAMES

        remote = self.get_remote(name=name, command=command)
        if hash_name in LEGACY_HASH_NAMES:
            return remote.legacy_odb
        return remote.odb
